errors.text_span: The horizontal axis displays the categories, labeled with numerical values ranging from approximately 9.60 to 28.29, arranged in ascending order.
errors.evidence: The horizontal axis represents the categories but it is not labeled. The numerical values mentioned are the heights of the bars (y-values), not labels on the x-axis. The bars are also not arranged in ascending order of their height.
The chart contains 12 bars, not seven.

errors.text_span: each a different shade of grey-blue
errors.evidence: The bars are of various distinct colors, including green, purple, mauve, brown, orange, and pink, not just shades of grey-blue.

errors.text_span: The first bar, corresponding to approximately 9.60 on the horizontal axis, is a dark grey-blue and has a height of 15.15.
errors.evidence: This description incorrectly states the first bar 'corresponds to 9.60 on the horizontal axis'; the horizontal axis is unlabeled, and 9.60 is the value of the third bar. The height of the first bar is correctly stated as 15.15, but its color is teal/green, not dark grey-blue.

errors.text_span: The tallest bar, corresponding to approximately 28.29 on the horizontal axis, is a medium grey-blue and reaches a height of 25.66.
errors.evidence: The tallest bar has a value of 28.29, not 25.66. The value 25.66 corresponds to the second-tallest bar.
The description states there are seven bars and only lists seven values, omitting five of the twelve bars shown in the chart. The omitted bars have values of 9.60, 11.37, 28.29, 23.47, and 24.01.

The description lists 11 values for the bars in an incorrect order and misses two values. The chart shows 12 bars, and the correct order of values is 15.15, 25.66, 9.60, 11.37, 28.29, 18.80, 21.88, 23.79, 17.27, 22.41, 23.47, and 24.01.

errors.text_span: The horizontal axis displays the categories, labeled from left to right with values
errors.evidence: The horizontal axis is not labeled. The numerical values are annotations located above each bar, not labels on the axis itself.
The description states the bars are 'gray-blue', but the figure clearly shows that the bars are multicolored, including shades of green, purple, blue, pink, and brown.
The description claims no bars are emphasized by annotation. However, every bar has a prominent numerical annotation above it displaying its precise value, which is a key feature of the chart.
